create_select_act_component: create a SelectActComponent with a language model and context key for agent action selection
get_action_attempt_free: call get_action_attempt to generate a free-form action string from context using the language model
get_action_attempt_choice: call get_action_attempt to select from multiple choice options based on agent context
get_action_attempt_float: call get_action_attempt to sample a float value from the language model given context
get_set_component_state: serialize and restore SelectActComponent state using get_state and set_state methods
